components.gap: The proof boundary def:p15-feller-moment-scope (handbook/parts/p15/feller-bernstein-hausdorff.tex 422-435) declares the supplied route as Feller VII.1-VII.4 and lists separate continuations (VII.5-VII.6, transform continuity, original Hausdorff and Heyde papers, later analytic moment proof), but neither supplies nor demarcates several source items inside the required extent pp.219-230: (i) the p.228 claim that knowledge of finitely many moments yields inequalities for F similar to those of V,7 (Markov, Stieltjes and footnote-3 literature); (ii) the p.229 remark that the theorem makes laws of large numbers and the central limit theorem applicable to exchangeable variables (problem 21 in VIII,10); (iii) the p.229 footnote-5 pointer to the general version (Hewitt-Savage 1956, Loeve, Buehlmann) is not linked to its on-route treatment; (iv) the p.226 footnote-1 alternative route through the Riesz representation theorem of V,1 or the convergence theorem of VIII,1 is not recorded as a separate source variant. Each must be supplied with a cross-reference or explicitly retained as a separate presentation for the boundary to be complete.
